page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one main column on the right; marginal notes in a column down the left margin. Page number and running head at the top. No catchword except "vobis" at the lower right.

main_text.p: culus,si illis temporibus natus esses, quum ab aratro arcessebantur, qui consules fierent; etenim, qui praesse agro colendo flagitium putes, profecto illum A-tilium, quem sua manu spargentem semen, qui missi erant, convenerunt, hominem turpissimum atque in-honestissimum iudicares.Quod Stapletono VVita-kerum carpenti, ob manuscriptum codicem cita-tum, quam apte perexigua mutatione convenit? Nae tu, Stapletone, ridiculus esses reprehensor, si illis temporibus natus esses, quando typographia ainventa nondum erat, nisi forte in terra Sinarum regionem antiquo nomine vocat Angelus Roccha, [in append. comment. de Biblioth. Vatican.] qui typographicam artem annu ante Christum natum quadringentis in nsu ibi fuisse narrat ex Michaele Rogerii Iesuitae & aliorum testimonio.* Chinae:etenim, qui nullos autores cum iudicio & graviter citari putes praeter excusos, profecto Paulum apostolu, quae no solumb Act.13.33. Rom.1.2.& 3.21.& 4.3.b Prophetas, sedc Act.17.28. Tit.1.12. c poetas e-tiam, quum manuscripti tantum exstarent, citasse patet, hominem levissimum atque insipientissi-mum iudicares. At nec Iudaei Beroeae de illo sic existimabant; sedd Act 17. ver. II. d scrutabantur Scripturas an ita se haberent quae praedicaverat: nec Athe-nis Graeci; sede ver.34. e adhaeserunt ei quidam, & crediderunt, in quibus Dionysius Areopagita. Quod si VVitakerus barbarus est scriptor, quia huiusmodi (ut ais) penes pauco s[?] habentur, itaque non posset mendacij sui convinci, nisi difficillime, cui mentiri libet: potesne demonstrare penes plures fuisse Arati & aliorum poetarum scripta, ne Paulus item barbarus doctor vocaretur, quia non poterat nisi difficillime convinci sui mendacij, si mentitus esset? An ideo delinquit, quia magistro-rum dictata (ut addis) suis tantum discipulis tradi-ta, nec magister ipse tanti semper facit, ut in lucem venire velit nisi saltem recognita: nec, si tanti faceret, nisi a Censoribus legitime ap-probata in lucem venire debent? Licebit ergo vobis

page.notes: Left margin notes a, *, b, c, d, e are placed at their reference marks in the text; the margin positions differ slightly. Uncertain readings: "annu" (possibly annum), "nsu" (possibly usu with an abbreviation mark), "pauco s" (possibly a word split at the margin), and the mark before "sed" on the line "sed e adhaeserunt", which reads like c but matches note e. The first word "culus" is a fragment carried over from the previous page. "Atilium" is split as "A-tilium" at the line end. The ligatures and long s have been normalised to plain s. The margin notes "Mi chaelis Roge rii" were joined without a hyphen because no hyphen is clearly printed.
